title: Deployment tiling cheatsheet and BOM playground (working) 2026
summary: Working cheatsheet for quickly iterating GPU tiling shapes, rack-level BOMs, and regional split heuristics. Lightweight calculator + rules-of-thumb for early scoping conversations with customers and sales engineering.
content:
PURPOSE:
This is a lightweight, intentionally messy playground for:
- sketching tiling shapes (how many GPUs per node / rack / region),
- quick BOM line-item estimates (GPU, host, PSU, NVMe, NIC, rackU),
- utilization and safety-buffer rules-of-thumb for VPC/private deployments,
- capturing open questions to hand off to procurement/solutions.

CONTEXT / WHEN TO USE: (notes to self)
- Use in early sales scoping when customer gives projected qps / token mix but not final SLAs.
- Use as a quick double-check when regional split or heterogeneous SKU mixes are being debated.
- Not for final procurement — hand off to formal BOM workbook after alignment on RAIDs, supplier leads, and power/cooling constraints.

ASSUMPTIONS (editable):
- baseline model footprint: 70B quantized (8-bit w/ KV caching) -> ~26GB GPU memory working set per inference session at 2k context average.
- per-GPU token throughput estimate (steady-state, single-stream average):
  - A100 80GB (fp16/AMP optim): ~12k tokens/sec per GPU at p50 latency targets
  - H100 80GB: ~18k tokens/sec per GPU (kernel optimized)
  - L40s 48GB: ~9k tokens/sec per GPU (cost-focused)
- target utilization: 65% (production target) with 20% headroom for spikes -> operational floor 52% effective capacity.
- spare+failover: 10% hot spares at region level; additional cross-region fallback planned.
- rack hostization: 8 GPUs per 2U (when using 8x SXM), 4 GPUs per 1U (when using PCIe style).

QUICK FORMULAS (copy/paste into sheet):
- required_gpus = ceil(peak_tokens_per_sec / tokens_per_sec_per_gpu / target_utilization)
- required_nodes = ceil(required_gpus / gpus_per_node)
- rack_count = ceil(required_nodes / nodes_per_rack)
- purchase_with_spares = ceil(required_gpus * (1 + spare_ratio))

EXAMPLE SCENARIOS (playground):
1) Small regional pilot (US-WEST)
- target peak: 250k tokens/sec total (mix of chat + completions)
- SKU: H100 80GB (18k tps)
- compute-only estimate: required_gpus = ceil(250000 / 18000 / 0.65) = ceil(21.37) -> 22 GPUs
- with 10% spares -> 25 GPUs -> 6 nodes @4 GPUs/node (PCIe host) -> 2 racks (40U typical)
- notes: power per rack ~30kW (including host, networking, PDU), plan redundant 20kW PDUs per rack

2) Multi-region baseline for enterprise customer (N.A. + EU)
- global peak tokens/sec: 1.8M (burstable to 2.5M)
- regional split: 70% NA, 30% EU (apply safety buffer + cross-region fallback)
- use mixed SKUs: 50% H100 / 50% L40s to control cost for non-latency-critical models
- compute math (NA): 1.26M tokens/sec -> required_gpus_NA = ceil(1,260,000 / (0.5*18000 + 0.5*9000) / 0.65) approximates using weighted avg tokens/gpu -> weighted = 13500 -> ceil(1,260,000 / 13500 / 0.65) = ceil(143.6) -> 144 gpus
- add 10% spares + 15% surge fabric = 144 * 1.25 = 180 gpus -> rack/host mapping depends on mix; if using 8x SXM hosts for H100 portion, plan fractional racks for heterogeneity.

RACK-LEVEL BOM CHEAT (examples):
- Host (8x SXM) per node: 1x baseboard (2U) + 8x GPU + 2x 4000W PSUs + 12x NVMe 4TB (local cache) + 2x 200Gb NIC
- Host (4x PCIe) per node: 1U server + 4x GPU + 1x 2000W PSU + 6x NVMe 2TB + 2x 100Gb NIC
- Top-of-Rack: 2x 100Gb switches (leaf), 1x management switch
- Rack infrastructure: PDUs (2 redundant), KVM, cold aisle blanking, airflow management
- Optics/cabling estimated per rack: $8k

ESTIMATED UNIT COST GUIDELINES (rough, vendor-dependent):
- H100 80GB GPU (OEM): $45k – $70k (volume / contract dependent)
- A100 80GB (OEM): $30k – $45k
- L40s 48GB: $12k – $18k
- 8x GPU baseboard host (2U): $35k – $60k (included PSUs, mobo, mem, CPU)
- 4x GPU 1U host: $18k – $28k
- NVMe 4TB (enterprise): $1.2k each
- 200Gbps NIC (per host): $3k
- Rack / PDU / switching (per rack): $35k – $60k

SAMPLE BOM OUTPUT (naive) FOR EXAMPLE #1 (pilot):
- H100 GPUs: 25 units -> assume $55k each -> $1.375M
- 4x GPU hosts needed: 25 GPUs / 4 = 7 hosts (round up) -> 7 x $25k = $175k
- NVMe + networking + rack infra -> $45k
- Total hardware est (pilot): ~$1.595M + taxes/shipping/integration (~10%) -> ~$1.75M

UTILIZATION / ECONOMICS NOTES:
- Effective capacity at target_utilization 65% is what we price against for SLA commitments.
- If customer wants 99th percentile latency SLAs, re-run tokens_per_sec_per_gpu with lower concurrency assumptions (costs up).
- Batching and KV cache effectiveness materially improves tokens/sec for chat-style repeated prefixes; assume +20–40% effective throughput if cache hit rate >70%.

OPERATIONAL RULES-OF-THUMB (for scoping):
- For pilot -> use 15–20% additional buffer vs required_gpus to avoid immediate reorders.
- For enterprise rollout -> plan 25% spare+surge headroom and stagger purchases in 3 waves to avoid massive capital tie-up.
- Prefer homogeneous racks where possible (all H100 or all L40s) to simplify heat/power planning; mix only at region or rack boundaries.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs:
- confirm vendor lead times for H100s in Q3 2026 (Ravi to check with procurement).
- validate per-GPU tokens/sec numbers with serving-runtime team for 2k sequence average workloads (Lena).
- clarify whether customer wants N+1 cooling redundancy per rack for on-prem data center (Tom).
- add a small worksheet to predict savings from quantization + INT8 profiles for certain models.

NOTES TO SELF:
- This doc intentionally flattens a lot of nuance — always follow up with the detailed BOM workbook once SKU and rack topology locked.
- Keep a separate tab of thermal maps for customer DC rooms.

CHANGE LOG (quick):

END.
